title: DC electronic load
spec: 150 W · 0.6–58 V · 0–10 A · 4 × IRFP250N · isolated USB-C
summary: A programmable DC load for testing power supplies and batteries. Rev B was built in late 2024 as a control board and a power board; a schematic review found errors in the power board. Rev E, the current design, uses four MOSFETs with one current loop each, isolation from USB, and is placed but not yet routed.
